# rust test suite

## Source

The parser tests of rust-analyzer (github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer, MIT or Apache-2.0), as published in the crate `ra_ap_parser`: the `.rs` files of `crates/parser/test_data/parser/{ok,err,inline/ok,inline/err}`, in `valid/` and `invalid/`. The files left out, and why, are in `../corpus/NOTICE`.

## Version

`ra_ap_parser` 0.0.347, edition 2024.
